sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Claude built, animated and rendered a 26-second RiskMandate film in Unreal Engine 5.8 on an unattended MacBook Air.
sections.para: In one session: a failed install fixed, Unreal's experimental MCP plugin connected, a folder-based job runner for rendering, and a brand film about reach, mandate and gap at 2560 by 1440. The render test and both versions of the film play on the page, streamed from the newsroom's new media vault.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: A laptop film studio, the first film, the MCP plugin, a job runner, three videos on the page, and what is next.
sections.para: Six points from the session notes.

sections.label: Watch it
sections.line: Three videos play on the page: the render test and both versions of the film.
sections.para: Each is streamed piece by piece from the newsroom's media vault, whose read key is published, and decrypted in the reader's browser.

sections.label: From a failed install to a working editor
sections.line: Three blockers on a locked-down Mac: a failed install, a missing Metal toolchain, and sleep.
sections.para: Ownership fixed, the toolchain downloaded as the normal user, sleep off on power.

sections.label: Connecting Claude to the editor
sections.line: Unreal 5.8's experimental MCP plugin exposes about fifty toolsets with All Toolsets on.
sections.para: Epic's Agent Skills, read through MCP, explained the first white-out and shaped the lighting.

sections.label: Closing the gap with a folder
sections.line: A job runner in a startup Python file runs any job dropped into an inbox folder, including the render.
sections.para: A tool that reported success without doing the work was worked around by editing the project file directly.

sections.label: The film
sections.line: Six beats in 26 seconds: an agent, 108 blocks of reach, green mandate, a barrier, a seal, the end card.
sections.para: Version 2 added bevels, materials, softer light and four samples per frame; 26 minutes to render against 3.5.

sections.label: What went wrong
sections.line: False success, stale copies, jobs inside jobs, and exposure.

sections.label: Why this matters
sections.line: An agent drives a production pipeline end to end, from a conversation; a series is as easy as one film.
sections.para: The next step is to turn the folder into proper tools.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: One session, one machine, one film; the plugin is experimental; the film is silent.
sections.para: Typed titles, not approved logo files yet.

sections.line: The session notes and the films in the media vault.
